_comment: Live-stack verification ledger (scripts/contract/verify-screens.mjs). Each entry is an endpoint that answers a non-2xx on purpose TODAY (honest 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED stubs, or a loader/route contract mismatch awaiting a product decision). Not a blanket carve-out: the live verifier requires every entry to keep returning exactly the recorded status and FAILS if it changes (e.g. 200 once the endpoint ships), so a stale entry cannot linger. Distinct from known-broken-chains.json, which is keyed to the STATIC chain status. Added 2026-10-07 with the Live Stack Verification fix (PR fix/main-ci-final-gates).
